strategy.primary: cEDH Wizard combo from the command zone: Inalla's Eminence copies each Wizard ETB (Spellseeker, Scholar of the Ages, Bloodline Necromancer, Ruthless Technomancer) for {1}, turning tutors and reanimation into Scholar sacrifice loops or the Bloodline/Technomancer loop for unbounded mana and Wizards.
strategy.secondary: Commander-free backups: Thassa's Oracle + Consultation/Tainted Pact and Underworld Breach + LED + Brain Freeze/Wheel of Fortune.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Inalla, Archmage Ritualist
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Eminence — Whenever another nontoken Wizard you control enters, if Inalla is in the command zone or on the battlefield, you may pay {1}. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that Wizard. The token gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.
Tap five untapped Wizards you control: Target player loses 7 life.

identity.why: Eminence copies of every Wizard ETB, plus a 7-life five-Wizard tap.
Mana-value-7 Wizard at the centre of the sacrifice loops.
Half of the commander loop and Wizard reanimation.
Wizard tutor for the combo instants and sorceries, doubled by Eminence.
